adventurer_manuscript.entity.tiger.page_: The §l§n§dTiger§r is a §lmedium-sized§r wild feline, prowling through §ltropical forests§r and §lbamboo jungles§r. Extremely agile and territorial, it attacks without warning.

§l§nI. Beast Leap: 

§r When it spots a target, the §l§n§dTiger§r performs a precise and powerful leap, aiming to immobilize and trap its prey with its razor-sharp claws.

If it catches you, it slashes you with its
§lclaws§r, dealing damage while keeping you §ltrapped§r under its strength and power, until it releases you.

§l§nII. Disarmament: 

§r The §l§n§dTiger§r's strikes are precise enough to force a player to §ldrop§r their equipment.

§l§nIII. Territorial: 

§r The §l§n§dTiger§r regularly claws tree trunks in its hunting zone, leaving visible marks on the bark. These marks serve to signal its presence and deter intruders.

§l§nIV. Rest: 

§r The §l§n§dTiger§r alternates its activity phases with periods of §lrest§r, retreating to safe areas to recover its energy before §lresuming§r the hunt.
§l§nAnalysis§r: Territorial predator - Must be avoided at all costs.
adventurer_manuscript.entity.boa.page_1: Being among the largest existing §lserpents§r, the §l§n§dBoa§r, observable in §lwarm swamps§r and §ljungles§r, is not a predator to be taken lightly.
adventurer_manuscript.entity.boa.page_2:
§l§nI. Envenomation: 

§r The §l§n§dBoa§r's fangs are often soaked with §ltoxin§r.





This can §lblur the vision§r of entities bitten by
adventurer_manuscript.entity.boa.page_3:
it. 
Once envenomed, the immune defenses of affected entities are §nradically§r §lless effective§r.

At this point, it's preferable to use an §l§n§dantidote§r to limit the §nspread§r of the §lvenom§r.
adventurer_manuscript.entity.boa.page_4:
§l§nII. Undulation: 

§r The §l§n§dBoa§r's body, of impressive length, is also perfectly §nadapted§r to swimming. A trait that allows it to §leasily pursue you§r in water if you attempt to flee.
adventurer_manuscript.entity.boa.page_5:
§l§nIII. Asphyxiation: 

§r The §l§n§dBoa§r doesn't always need to bite. It can §lcoil around§r its prey and §lblock its breathing§r by squeezing with all its strength, dealing increasingly heavy damage over
adventurer_manuscript.entity.boa.page_6:
time, inflicting §lheavy damage§r. 

§l§nIV. Molting: 

§r When the time comes, the §l§n§dBoa§r begins to §nmolt§r, leaving its §lold skin§r on the ground, which can be §ncollected§r.
adventurer_manuscript.entity.boa.page_7: §l§nAnalysis§r: Powerful, silent and unpredictable predator, formidable at close range but less tough at distance - avoid.
adventurer_manuscript.entity.kodiak.page: Often overlooked, the §l§n§dKodiak§r is one of the most §lpowerful§r and §nimposing§r §lbear§r species one can encounter, especially within the §lredwood forests§r and their §lden§r.

§l§nI. Gluttony: 

§r The §l§n§dKodiak§r is a §ngluttonous§r bear, obsessed with food. Nothing escapes it. It can §lrummage§r through your chests to steal food, ravage your §lcrops§r in seconds, and approach

§ncampfires§r to grab §lfood§r cooking on them — even picking up anything §llying§r on the ground. 

§l§nII. Fisher: 

§r The §l§n§dKodiak§r also excels in the art of §nfishing§r. Once it dives into the water, it
attracts §l§n§dsalmon§r toward itself like a magnet. When one §lgets too close§r, it snaps its §npowerful jaws§r shut, leaving no chance of escape.

§l§nIII. Tranquility: 

§r The §l§n§dKodiak§r isn’t always a §lfierce§r beast. Most of the time, it remains §ncalm§r. You can see it §lsleeping§r for hours, §lrolling§r around in the grass, §lscratching§r lazily against §ntree trunks§r

or simply §lsitting§r to §nobserve its surroundings§r.


§l§nIV. Alliance: 

§r The §l§n§dKodiak§r lives peacefully with §lbees§r, defending their hives if they are

attacked, and occasionally taking their §lhoney§r.

 §l§nAnalysis§r: A big eater — peaceful if left alone, but fearsome once provoked.
adventurer_manuscript.entity.crocodile.p: Possessing one of the most powerful jaws ever recorded, the §l§n§dCrocodile§r is a §ncunning and patient§r predator, lurking within §lmarshy§r §lareas§r near §nwater sources§r.

§l§nI. Carcasses: 

§r Once its prey is devoured, the §l§n§dCrocodile§r sometimes leaves behind the §nskeletal carcass§r of its meal. It can be §lextracted§r with a pickaxe to recover its bones.

§l§nII. Death Roll: 

§r The §l§n§dCrocodile§r can grab its prey both on §lland§r and in the §lwater§r. When it seizes a victim on land, it §ldrags§r them into the water to §nkeep§r them under its control.
In the water, it performs its fearsome §lDeath Roll§r — a fast, devastating spin that §ltears apart§r the prey’s flesh while disorienting it, making escape §nimpossible§r.

§l§nIII. Gaping Maw: 

§r When it spots a target, the §l§n§dCrocodile§r can slowly open its jaws and §ncautiously§r advance, ready to strike. If it manages to bite, the victim suffers the
§lFracture§r effect, preventing them from §lrunning§r or §lattacking§r properly — while the §l§n§dCrocodile§r becomes §nfaster§r in pursuit.
boa.page1: The §lBoa§r is a silent predator slithering through dense, §lhumid§r §lareas§r patiently awaiting its prey.
boa.page2: Its bite, quick and precise, can inject both §lVenom§r and §lPoison§r, weakening its victims within moments.
boa.page3: But the danger doesn't stop there—the §lBoa§r can also §lcoil§r around its prey with relentless force, slowly suffocating it until §lasphyxiation§r.
boa.page4: §l§nAnalysis§r: Treacherous animal — formidable for reckless adventurers, but less threatening to seasoned explorers.
peacock.page1: The §lPeacock§r is a bird as graceful as it is spectacular, found in flowery places like §lmeadows§r or §lflower§r §lforests§r.
peacock.page2: When danger approaches, it unfurls its impressive §lfan§r of shimmering feathers. This gesture, both sudden and theatrical, often suffices to §ldrive§r §laway§r predators, troubled by its menacing beauty. But this same display can also serve another purpose entirely—seduction. During mating season, the male §lproudly§r §lstruts§r, hoping to impress a female.
peacock.page3: When a pair forms, they may lay an §legg§r, from which a baby peacock will hatch, adding even more grace to the landscape.
peacock.page4: §l§nAnalysis§r: Peaceful creature — fascinating to observe, but never to be underestimated.
tiger_shark.page1: The §lTiger§r §lShark§r is a powerful species of §lShark§r that swims exclusively in §lcold§r, §ldeep§r §lwaters§r, constantly hunting for prey, and often lurking dangerously near §lSunken§r §lStations§r.
tiger_shark.page2: This predator has a highly §lcurious§r temperament, which sharply contrasts with its stealthy §laggression§r, often ambushing targets from behind to catch them off guard.
tiger_shark.page3: A vicious bite from a §lTiger§r §lShark§r may also trigger severe §lbleeding§r, causing nearby §lSharks§r to become more aggressive, and capable of dragging victims into the dark §ldepths§r below.
tiger_shark.page4: Still, some §lTiger§r §lSharks§r may be calmed if they charge—at the exact moment a fresh §lSalmon§r is presented as an offering or distraction.
boa.taming.page1: The §lBoa§r is a large and long snake species, feeding exclusively on the flesh of fierce large animals like §lRaw§r §lTiger§r, which it usually finds directly on the ground.
boa.taming.page2: When it spots one, it §lslowly§r §lapproaches§r, then devours it whenever it feels the urge.
boa.taming.page3: However, during taming, if the §lBoa§r catches sight of a target, its appetite §lfades§r instantly. As long as its eyes remain locked on it, it §lignores§r the meat on the ground completely.
peacock.taming.page1: It is impossible to tame an adult §lPeacock§r. However, it is entirely possible to bond with a §lbaby§r §lPeacock§r from the moment it hatches.
peacock.taming.page2: To do so, watch for a male Peacock performing a §lcourtship display§r near a §lfemale§r.
peacock.taming.page3: Feed them both a few §lSavage§r §lBerries§r to encourage their bonding and trigger the laying of an §legg§r.
peacock.taming.page4: Then, be patient: wait for §lthe egg§r to §lhatch§r and the baby §lPeacock§r to emerge. Once born, offer it a few §lSavage§r §lBerries§r to tame it.
tiger.taming.page1: Taming a §lTiger§r is a delicate task that requires §lcaution§r and §lpatience§r.
tiger.taming.page2: To do so, equip yourself with a §lbow§r or a §lMaya§r §lblowpipe§r, along with a supply of §ltranquilizer§r §larrows§r or §ldarts§r to send the beast into a §ldeep§r §lsleep§r. Be careful: the §lTiger’s§r sleep fades over time. Make sure not to waste a second once the taming begins.
tiger.taming.page3: Once deeply asleep, the §lTiger§r must be fed with meat from dangerous animals, such as §lRaw§r §lBoa§r.

owteams.reputation.activate.title: Enable Tribe Reputation?
owteams.reputation.activate.desc: Reputation reflects your tribe's prestige. It grows as your members tame and raise their creatures, and rewards active, united tribes with Gold, Jade and Ruby badges.
owteams.reputation.activate.wait: Only the chief or a deputy can enable it.
owteams.reputation.tooltip: The tribe's prestige score, drawn from every member's creatures (count, level, dangerousness), taming experience and level-50 creatures. Several active members create synergy that pushes the score up.
owteams.reputation.legend.1: Members' creatures: count, level and dangerousness.
owteams.reputation.legend.3: Synergy bonus based on the number of active members.
owteams.arena.title: Arena
owteams.arena.intro.headline: Welcome to the Arena
owteams.arena.intro.p1: The Arena pits the server's tribes against each other in organised battles. Every victory earns your tribe reputation and prestige points shared by all its members.
owteams.arena.intro.p2: Prestige points accumulate at tribe level. Every 300 points, each member unlocks a chest they open individually: nobody keeps the others from their reward.
owteams.arena.intro.p3: A chest's quality depends on your tribe's reputation badge at the moment it is opened. A Gold, Jade or Ruby badge grants increasingly rich loot in materials, gear and Wild Coins.
owteams.arena.intro.p4: Only the chief may challenge another tribe, and only the opposing chief may accept. Both chiefs then pick up to five fighters of different archetypes, and the battle plays out in a dedicated dimension.
owteams.arena.intro.warning: Warning: committing your tribe to the Arena is permanent. An accepted battle can no longer be cancelled.
owteams.arena.intro.wait: Only the chief can commit the tribe.

ow.attacks.orca.big_mouth.desc: Your Orca gulps down the entity ahead: an ally breathes freely inside for %s seconds, a foe is crushed and starved of air for %s seconds. Press again to spit it out. Recharge with %s kills every %s seconds.

ow.attacks.orca.combo.desc: Make your Orca bite every %s seconds, dealing %s damage per bite.
ow.attacks.orca.combo.title: Snap
ow.attacks.orca.tidal_rush.desc: Launch your Orca along its snout, dealing %s damage to whatever it strikes. Aim at the surface to burst clear of the water. Every %s seconds.
ow.attacks.orca.tidal_rush.title: Ocean Surge
ow.attacks.orca.slipstream.desc: Within %s blocks, your tamed creatures and tribe members swim %s%% faster and hold their breath %s%% longer.

tooltip.elephantSkin1.desc: Solid gold plating over four tonnes of muscle. Unlocks at level 50.
tooltip.elephantSkin2.desc: Membranous wings and blackened tusks: something came back up with him.
tooltip.elephantSkin3.desc: The flesh gave out long ago. The march did not.
ow.attacks.elephant.combo.title: Trample
ow.attacks.elephant.combo.desc: Make your Elephant strike every %s seconds, dealing %s damage per blow.
ow.attacks.elephant.shoulder_bash.title: Shoulder Bash
ow.attacks.elephant.shoulder_bash.desc: Right-click: the Elephant hurls itself toward the side you are looking at, dealing %s damage and flinging aside everything in its path. %s second cooldown.
ow.attacks.elephant.earthquake.title: Earthquake
ow.attacks.elephant.earthquake.desc: Charges with %s kills. The Elephant rears up, then drops its full weight: a shockwave across %s blocks, up to %s damage at the centre, shattered ground and shaking cameras. %s second cooldown.
ow.attacks.elephant.lumberjack.title: Lumberjack
ow.attacks.elephant.lumberjack.desc: At full charge, the Elephant fells the whole tree it rams in one go and pulls %s%% more wood from it.
ow.attacks.elephant.water_spray.title: Trunk Jet
ow.attacks.elephant.water_spray.desc: Hold right-click: at the water's edge the Elephant fills its trunk; anywhere else it sprays over %s blocks, shoving back whatever it sweeps and putting out fires. Holding the jet on one lava block for %s seconds turns it to stone. The reserve slowly leaks away.
